title: Approve a recipe: passkey didn't finish
summary: The approve drawer after the passkey check was cancelled or failed: a danger strip above the foot says nothing was approved and how to try again; the comparison is unchanged.
compare: The drawer opens from Review and approve… on the minted-token entry with the editor dimmed behind; there is no separate Edge mint page.
The screen is one viewport: the page behind doesn't scroll and the drawer fills the height, with its body scrolling and its foot always visible.

What changed compares every security-relevant field against the last approval, headed "Approved Sep 14 by Ana Lima": changed fields first, with the old value struck in a danger tint with −, the new value bold in a success tint with +; then an Unchanged sub-head over one value per field. The eyebrow counts "1 field changed".
A widening change gets a plain warning of what it allows (a leaked token works for 12 hours instead of 1); a narrowing change has none.
The signing key is never shown, only its state (Sealed Oct 2).
The only confirm is the passkey (step-up); P0-12 holds: nothing mints until the approval is recorded.
Phone: the drawer fills the screen, the comparison stays a three-column table inside its card with values on one line, and the buttons fill the width.

The error sits directly above the foot, in the danger tone with an icon and role alert: "The passkey check didn't finish, so nothing was approved. Try again; if your passkey isn't on this device, use your phone."
The primary becomes Try again with passkey; Cancel closes the drawer with nothing changed. The recipe still reads Changed since approval behind it.
